data.description:
Addendum to existing finding #58: the new contribution is verified response content sufficient for DeepSearchQA question 250 and a reproducible comparison matching its reference answer. The marker/volume context is existing evidence; neither marker spelling nor this answer match establishes a named AI provider.

The civilrightsdata.ed.gov archive shows extensive variation of states, measures, survey years and other API selectors, concentrated principally on June 16-17, 2026. Within that history, four responses captured on June 16 at 23:55:06-23:55:09 UTC supply the inputs needed for DeepSearchQA question 250. Metadata responses verify that survey key 9 denotes 2017-18, measure 130 counts reported victims of harassment/bullying based on race, color or national origin, and stCOUNSEL gives school-counselor FTE.

The four archived state results contain: North Carolina 1856.11 counselor FTE and 272 victims; South Carolina 829.27 and 191; Virginia 1505.13 and 375; Georgia 1410.26 and 530. Dividing FTE by victims gives approximately 6.8239, 4.3417, 4.0137 and 2.6609 respectively. Our reconstruction therefore yields North Carolina, matching the public benchmark reference answer. All four response identities and exact capture timestamps were validated. Four later COUNSEL responses independently carry matching counselor values even though some other fields are null.

This establishes answer-sufficient public data recovery, not that the requester calculated the answer, submitted it, or was executing a formal benchmark. The surrounding collection is much broader than a four-state comparison. Schema discovery, retries, multiple tasks or repeated runs could contribute; the evidence does not distinguish them or identify an operator or AI company. This is ordinary public-data querying and enumeration, not an established injection, access-control bypass or denial-of-service event. Archive counts are not an origin request-rate measurement. A separate SQL-shaped probe on June 17 must not be causally attributed to this earlier data set based on timing alone.

Untapped source is Yes: the declared exact-host union contains 253,991 distinct timestamp/URL observations, while response bodies have only been verified for selected cases. Substantial known archive metadata and unreviewed response candidates remain available for task/outcome analysis. Counts include ordinary assets, repeats and errors, not that many attacks or unique actors.
data.summary: Extensive CRDC API enumeration includes four June 16 responses sufficient to solve DeepSearchQA Q250. Our reconstruction matches its reference answer; agent computation and benchmark execution remain unproved.
